verdict.rationale: Airweave supports unifying and syncing many source connections into collections and searching across them in a single query (bulk-scale search/sync), but there is no documented evidence of user-driven bulk operations like batch-deleting, batch-updating, or bulk-editing many items/connections at once. missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/delete/update APIs or UI, batch job endpoints, evidence of operating on many items simultaneously beyond sync/search.
